$comment: Documented license exceptions checked by scripts/check-licenses.mjs (decision DEC-6).
Every package whose license is not in licenses-allowed.json needs one entry here:
package = npm package name, version = exact version or "*",
license = the license string reported by license-checker (SPDX expression),
reason = why it is accepted (required, non-empty),
status = "approved" or "pending-owner-decision" (pending entries pass with a WARNING).
Entries that match no installed package fail the check, so remove them with the dependency.
GPL and AGPL packages cannot be excepted.
Order: ISC (existing toolchain), ISC (license-checker-rseidelsohn), BlueOak-1.0.0, MIT-0, Creative Commons data packages, MPL-2.0.
